senses.gloss: = לֵית, not. Y. Maas. Sh. V, beg. 55ᵈ למה לי נן מרין why do we not say?—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 3:5:12">Y. Snh. III, 21ᵇ</cite> <he>דלי אכיל וכ׳</he> for I eat no unclean meat; a. fr.—<cite ref="L00488"><he>לֵינָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="L00488"><he>לֵינָה</he></cite> = <he>לֵי אֲנָא</he>; <he>לֵינָן</he> = <he>לֵי אֲנָן</he>. Ib. I, beg. 18ᵃ <he>דל׳ חכים מידון</he> that I know not how to judge. Ib. X, 28ᵇ <he>לינה מיזל</he> I will not go.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>ול׳ יכול וכ׳</he> and I cannot bear it.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 2:6:4">Y. Orl. II, 62ᶜ</cite> top <he>ואנן ל׳ אמרין כן</he> but we do not say so.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 9:1:13">Y. Shebi. IX, 38ᵈ</cite> <he>ל׳ אזל מפלי וכ׳</he> will I not go and make sport of that elder of the Jews?, i.e. I will go &c.; a. fr.
